name: tt-deploy
description: Take a model from host discovery to a verified server on Tenstorrent hardware. discover answers the Discovery-stage host questions: host facts, driver, boards vs ASICs, hugepages, docker, HF cache, port 8000, device holders, the --tt-device string, firmware minimums, idle telemetry, reset verdict, deployable models, gating, disk, clean-box. retrieve resolves one model: HF existence, gating and config; the tt-inference-server spec entry (image, commits, status, ceilings, known_issues); image-vs-repo spec drift; GHCR tag, size and ancestry; run.py vs docker; and the tt-model-manager bundle path. launch reads the launching container's own log/state to classify hangs and failures, mandatory docker flags, override safety, timing, and displaced services. verify checks health, generation correctness, mesh utilization, throughput/batching, and reasoning-model quirks against a live endpoint, with root-cause elimination when a check fails. Deterministic, evidence-based; every answer traces to a listed command's output, a captured log, a live request/response, or a listed static rule. Covers all four stages of the model-deployment journey.

interface.shortDescription: Discover the host, retrieve the model, diagnose the launch, and verify the server on Tenstorrent hardware
interface.longDescription: Answer the host Discovery questions deterministically (host facts, driver, boards vs ASICs, hugepages, docker, HF cache, port, device holders, --tt-device string, firmware minimums, idle telemetry, reset verdict, deployable models, disk, clean-box); resolve one model for Retrieval (HF existence and gating, tt-inference-server spec entry, image-vs-repo spec drift, GHCR tag/size/ancestry, run.py vs docker, tt-model-manager bundles, exact pull commands); diagnose a model launch that is running, hanging, or has failed (launch steps, mandatory docker flags, failure-signature classification, minimum-override selection and safety, override persistence, realistic timing, displaced services); and verify a live server is actually healthy, correct, and performant (health, served model/context, generation correctness, mesh utilization, throughput/batching, reasoning-model checks, root-cause elimination). Deterministic and evidence-based; read-only except for an explicit --pull.
capabilities: Host discovery: boards vs ASICs, --tt-device string, driver/firmware, hugepages, docker, device holders, reset verdict
Model retrieval: HF existence/gating, tt-inference-server spec entry, image spec drift, GHCR tag/size/ancestry, tt-model-manager bundles
Launch diagnostics: stage/hang/failure classification from container log and state
Mandatory docker flag and override verification
Server health, correctness, and generation checks
Mesh utilization, throughput, and batching verification
Reasoning-model quirk checks and root-cause elimination
defaultPrompt: Use discover to answer what this host is and what it can deploy: boards, driver, firmware, hugepages, docker, port 8000, device holders, and the --tt-device string.
Use retrieve --model <org>/<name> to resolve a model before pulling or launching: HF gating, the tt-inference-server spec entry, image drift, and the exact pull command.
Use launch --container <id> to diagnose a model launch that is running, hanging, or has failed, and get a ranked fix.
Use verify --endpoint http://localhost:<n> to check a running server is healthy, correct, and performant.
